mechanism: Voriconazole inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, reducing valproate metabolism and increasing valproate serum concentrations, while valproate may inhibit voriconazole metabolism via CYP2C19 inhibition.
action: Monitor valproate serum levels closely; consider dose reduction of valproate and assess for toxicity (tremor, ataxia, confusion); monitor voriconazole efficacy and adjust dosing if needed.
